Title: Rishabh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pihu - 13 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Hema - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Sanjay - 40 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Vimla - 71 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
4. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Pihu, Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Hema: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Pihu: "Okay, Dad."

[Rishabh does yoga on a mat.]

Pihu: "How beautiful!"

[Pihu skips rope.]

Rishabh (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh feeds the dog.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Rishabh milks the cow.]

Rishabh: "Hmm, I see."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Hema (laughing): "Mother, listen!"

[Rishabh pats his horse.]

Rishabh: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

[Rishabh stands in the snow. Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "What a nice place."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Rishabh (gently): "Okay, Mom."

[Rishabh makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Rishabh: "Dad, look at this."

[Rishabh builds a snowman.]

Sanjay: "That's easy."

[Rishabh catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Hema: "Okay, Sanjay."

[Rishabh slides down the snowy slope.]

Hema (softly): "What next?"

Scene 4: The main road - Day

[Rishabh stands on the road. Hema, Sanjay and Pihu stand near him.]

Pihu: "Look over here."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Rishabh sits in the back seat.]

Sanjay (happily): "What happened?"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Rishabh in the back.]

Pihu (gently): "What a day to remember!"
